summary: Iteration 7 · Fase B iter7 · 6-feature bundle. Backend pytest suite (19 tests) = 19/19 passing (backend_test_iter7.py). Frontend Playwright smoke on all key testids succeeded. Verified: (1) Access Tiles /api/system/modules returns 6 groups {lims,labforms,erp,hr,finance,system}; PATCH hr enabled OK; PATCH system enabled:false → 400 core-protected; unknown key → 404. Notes: hierarchy test uses role='supervisor' since 'analyst' lacks POST /samples permission (403); this matches production permissions. Test subordinate cleanup via DELETE /users/{id} left 2 residual 'TEST Subordinate' users in DB from earlier runs (delete-user endpoint may not exist).

critical_code_review_comments: hr_payroll.py: `_isr_monthly` control flow is convoluted — the inner if/else re-assigns tax_annual twice per matching bracket and the for/else fallback is confusing; consider a straight linear loop with `if lo < annual <= hi: tax = base + (annual - lo)*rate; break`. Output values happen to be correct for the tested salary but future maintainers may misread.
hr_payroll.py: cedula stripping done inline; consider extracting `_normalize_cedula(str) -> str` (DRY, reused in create/update/import).

system_modules.py: `_load_state()` returns a shallow merge — enabled state persists but `default_enabled=False` for hr means the very first tenant lands with hr hidden until admin toggles it once. Consider seeding docs on startup so /modules is deterministic post-migration.
auth_router.notify_supervisor_of swallows all exceptions silently; log at WARNING level so failed notifications aren't invisible.
samples.py hooks notify_supervisor_of inside try/except that swallows errors — mirror the concern above; observable failures preferred to silent drops.
